content: <@&1458826346896687229> https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/168 any objections to this? we wanna avoid that small operator errors, like adding a trailing slash can cause `auth.data` mismatches. The only caveat I can think of with this is that you cannot sign over the pubkey if it's part of the url, but there is always the option for builders to provide custom auth data that operators then configure instead. but I think hostname should be sufficient for the builder to uniquely be addressed
